ov: Tiny primates of the islands of Southeast Asia with enormous eyes: each eyeball is about 16 mm across and as big as the whole brain. They cling upright to trees, leap after prey, and can turn their heads 180 degrees each way.
rg: Maritime Southeast Asia, mainly Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.
df: Carnivore: mainly insects, caught by leaping on them.
fx: They are the only entirely carnivorous living primates.
Tarsiers have never formed successful breeding colonies in captivity.
